subject: Mathematics
title: Sequences and Series
summary: Arithmetic progression (AP) mein har baar ek fixed common difference d judta hai; geometric progression (GP) mein fixed ratio r se multiply hota hai. Harmonic progression (HP) AP ka reciprocal hai.
nth term aur sum ke formulas, infinite GP ka sum (|r| < 1), aur means AM, GM, HM yaad rakho — positive numbers ke liye AM ≥ GM ≥ HM. Do numbers ke beech means insert karna bhi aata hai.
Special series: Σn, Σn², Σn³, arithmetico-geometric progressions (AGP) aur telescoping (method of differences) JEE mein baar-baar aate hain.

formulas.name: AP properties
formulas.formula: three terms in AP: a − d, a, a + d;  if a, b, c in AP then 2b = a + c;  tₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁

formulas.name: Infinite GP
formulas.mistake: Sirf |r| < 1 ke liye valid — warna mat lagaana.

formulas.name: HP
formulas.formula: a, b, c in HP ⇔ 1/a, 1/b, 1/c in AP;  b = 2ac/(a + c)
formulas.mistake: HP ke sum ka koi formula nahi hai — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Means
formulas.formula: AM = (a + b)/2;  GM = √(ab);  HM = 2ab/(a + b);  GM² = AM × HM

formulas.name: AM–GM–HM inequality
formulas.formula: AM ≥ GM ≥ HM (equality iff all numbers equal)

formulas.name: Inserting means
formulas.formula: n AMs between a and b: d = (b − a)/(n + 1);  n GMs: r = (b/a)^{1/(n + 1)}

formulas.name: nth term from differences
formulas.formula: if successive differences of the terms form an AP, tₙ is quadratic in n; if they form a GP, tₙ = arⁿ + b
formulas.when: Anokhi series ka general term nikaalna.

examples.title: 4 aur 16 ke means
examples.problem: 4 aur 16 ka AM, GM aur HM nikalo.
examples.solution: AM = 10, GM = 8, HM = 6.4; check GM² = AM × HM: 64 = 10 × 6.4.

examples.title: AM–GM se minimum
examples.problem: x > 0 ke liye x + 9/x ka minimum nikalo.

topics.title: Choosing terms
topics.explain: Sum pata ho to AP ke liye a − d, a, a + d (teen terms) ya a − 3d, a − d, a + d, a + 3d (chaar terms) lo. GP ke liye a/r, a, ar.

topics.title: Properties of AP and GP
topics.explain: AP ke har term mein constant jodne, ghataane, multiply ya divide karne par wo AP hi rehta hai (0 se divide ke alawa). GP ke terms ko constant se multiply karne par GP hi rehta hai; GP ke reciprocals bhi GP; GP ke logs AP banate hain.

topics.title: Sum of n terms from Sₙ
topics.explain: Agar Sₙ, n ka function diya ho to tₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (n ≥ 2), t₁ = S₁. Bina constant term ka quadratic Sₙ matlab AP.

topics.title: Relation between AM, GM, HM
topics.explain: Positive a, b ke liye: A ≥ G ≥ H, G² = AH. a aur b, x² − 2Ax + G² = 0 ke roots hain.

topics.title: Series to recognise
topics.explain: 1 + 11 + 111 + … — 111…1 = (10ⁿ − 1)/9 likho. 0.7 + 0.77 + 0.777 + … — yahi trick. 1·2 + 2·3 + … jaise products ka sum = Σn² + Σn.

topics.title: Weighted AM–GM
topics.explain: Weights wale positive numbers ke liye weighted AM ≥ weighted GM. Sum constraint ke saath product maximise karne mein kaam aata hai, jaise x + y = 5 diya ho to x²y³ maximise karna.

ratta: GP: tₙ = arⁿ⁻¹;  S∞ = a/(1 − r).
HP: reciprocals in AP; b = 2ac/(a + c).
